mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as totalAmount, count(1) as orderCount, count(distinct supplier_id) as supplierCount, ifnull(avg(total_amount), 0) as avgAmount from erp_purchase_order where status in ('2', '4')

select date_format(order_date, '%m-%d') as date, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as amount from erp_purchase_order where status in ('2', '4') and order_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(order_date, '%m-%d') order by min(order_date)

select s.supplier_name as name, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as value from erp_purchase_order o left join erp_supplier s on s.supplier_id = o.supplier_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by o.supplier_id, s.supplier_name order by value desc limit 5

select o.order_no as no, s.supplier_name as supplierName, o.total_amount as amount, date_format(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, o.status as status from erp_purchase_order o left join erp_supplier s on s.supplier_id = o.supplier_id order by o.order_id desc limit 20

select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as totalAmount, count(1) as orderCount, count(distinct customer_id) as customerCount, ifnull(avg(total_amount), 0) as avgAmount from erp_sale_order where status in ('2', '4')

select date_format(order_date, '%m-%d') as date, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as amount from erp_sale_order where status in ('2', '4') and order_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(order_date, '%m-%d') order by min(order_date)

select m.material_name as name, ifnull(sum(i.quantity * i.price), 0) as value from erp_sale_order o join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by i.material_id, m.material_name order by value desc limit 5

select o.order_no as no, c.customer_name as customerName, m.material_name as productName, o.total_amount as amount, date_format(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, o.status as status from erp_sale_order o left join erp_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id left join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by o.order_id, c.customer_name, m.material_name order by o.order_id desc limit 20

select ifnull(sum(s.quantity), 0) as totalQty, ifnull(sum(s.quantity * m.purchase_price), 0) as totalValue, sum(case when s.quantity < m.safe_stock then 1 else 0 end) as lowCount, count(distinct s.warehouse_id) as warehouseCount from erp_stock s left join erp_material m on m.material_id = s.material_id

select m.material_name as name, ifnull(sum(s.quantity), 0) as value from erp_stock s left join erp_material m on m.material_id = s.material_id group by s.material_id, m.material_name order by value desc limit 5
select w.warehouse_name as name, ifnull(sum(s.quantity), 0) as value from erp_stock s left join erp_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id group by s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name

select date_format(r.record_date, '%m-%d') as date, sum(case when r.direction = '1' then r.quantity else 0 end) as inQty, sum(case when r.direction = '0' then r.quantity else 0 end) as outQty from erp_stock_record r where r.record_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(r.record_date, '%m-%d') order by min(r.record_date)

select m.material_code as code, m.material_name as name, w.warehouse_name as warehouse, s.quantity as stock, m.safe_stock as safeStock, m.unit as unit, case when s.quantity < m.safe_stock then '预警' else '正常' end as status from erp_stock s left join erp_material m on m.material_id = s.material_id left join erp_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id order by s.quantity desc
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as revenue from erp_sale_order where status in ('2', '4')

select ifnull(sum(i.quantity * m.purchase_price), 0) as cost from erp_sale_order o join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4')

select date_format(o.order_date, '%m月') as month, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as revenue, ifnull(max(c.cost), 0) as cost from erp_sale_order o left join ( select date_format(o2.order_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(i2.quantity * m2.purchase_price) as cost from erp_sale_order o2 join erp_sale_order_item i2 on i2.order_id = o2.order_id left join erp_material m2 on m2.material_id = i2.material_id where o2.status in ('2', '4') group by date_format(o2.order_date, '%Y-%m') ) c on c.ym = date_format(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') where o.status in ('2', '4') and year(o.order_date) = year(curdate()) group by date_format(o.order_date, '%Y-%m'), date_format(o.order_date, '%m月') order by date_format(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')

select m.material_name as name, ifnull(sum(i.quantity * i.price) - sum(i.quantity * m.purchase_price), 0) as value from erp_sale_order o join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by i.material_id, m.material_name order by value desc limit 5

select m.material_name as name, ifnull(sum(i.quantity * m.purchase_price), 0) as value from erp_sale_order o join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by i.material_id, m.material_name order by value desc limit 5

select o.order_no as no, c.customer_name as customerName, m.material_name as productName, o.total_amount as revenue, (select ifnull(sum(i2.quantity * m2.purchase_price), 0) from erp_sale_order_item i2 left join erp_material m2 on m2.material_id = i2.material_id where i2.order_id = o.order_id) as cost from erp_sale_order o left join erp_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id left join erp_sale_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where o.status in ('2', '4') group by o.order_id, c.customer_name, m.material_name order by o.order_id desc limit 20

select '采购订单' as name, count(1) as count from erp_purchase_order where status = '1' union all select '销售订单' as name, count(1) as count from erp_sale_order where status = '1' union all select '库存调拨' as name, count(1) as count from erp_stock_transfer where status = '1' union all select '收付款单' as name, count(1) as count from erp_payment where status = '1'
